content: वासन्त {%a.%} (-न्ती|{%f.%}) .²1 Vernal, suitable to or produced in spring. .²2 In the spring or prime of life, youthful. .²3 Diligent, attentive (in the performance of duties). .{@-न्तः@} .²1 A camel. .²2 A young elephant. .²3 Any young animal. .²4 A cuckoo. .²5 The south wind, the breeze blowing from the Malaya mountain; <ab>cf.</ab> मलयसमीर. .²6 A kind of bean. .²7 A dissolute man. .{@-न्ती@} .²1 A kind of jasmine (with fragrant flowers); वसन्ते वासन्तीकुसुमसुकुमारैरवयवैः <ls>Gīt. 1</ls>. .²2 Long pepper. .²3 The trumpet-flower. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a festival held in honour of Cupid; <ab>cf.</ab> वसन्तोत्सव. .²5 The spring creeper.
